title: PR-001 release gate registry v1 (G1..G7)
description: Validates release_gate_registry_v1.json: the frozen G1..G7 release gate table. Exactly seven entries. G0 is structurally excluded from `gates` and lives only in the separate bootstrap_gate object. The registry is CONFIGURATION only and MUST NOT carry any mutable execution status: additionalProperties:false, unevaluatedProperties:false and the forbiddenEntryKeys list below structurally prevent status/conclusion/verdict/last_run_at from creeping back in. Six of seven entries are release VERIFICATION gates bound to cwk.pr001.release_gate_receipt.v1; G7 alone is a release AUTHORIZATION bound to cwk.pr001.release_authorization_receipt.v1, with a different filename and a different domain separator.

receipt_root.description: Root of the release gate evidence subtree. Deliberately DISJOINT from gate-receipts/, which is already an exact VG-A..VG-E closure.

downstream_only_ids.description: IDs that are strictly downstream of every entry and must never appear in any required_prerequisite_ids. G7 authorizes; nothing verifies against it.

bootstrap_gate.description: G0, the pre-RT document review gate, held OUTSIDE the seven entries. It has no feeder RT, no machine receipt, no test evidence and no environment binding, so it cannot be modelled as a release gate entry without letting a Markdown file impersonate a verifiable gate.

in_registry.description: Always false. G0 is never one of the seven entries.

historical_narrative_ref.description: The round-4 review report. Provenance only, explicitly INSUFFICIENT to satisfy G0.

final_wave0_review_report_path.description: The FROZEN path of the final Wave-0 independent review report, the only artefact that can satisfy G0. It may legitimately be absent, in which case G0 is UNSATISFIED and G1 is NOT_RUN.

consumer_relation_model.description: Prose statement freezing the two distinct consumer relations: direct RT consumers (gate_registry_v1.json `consumers`, value space {RT-024, RT-026}) versus release-gate consumers (this file's `consumes_verification_gates`). Neither is derivable from the other.

owner_scope_model.description: The machine-readable definition of WHICH paths each gate owns. Without it owner_scope_tree_sha256 is unrecomputable and therefore unfalsifiable - any 64-hex value satisfies a format check. Code prefixes and evidence-output prefixes are kept disjoint so that evidence can never bootstrap its own subject binding.

scope_mode.description: FAIL-CLOSED by construction. Per-RT implementation allowlists are fail-OPEN - anything unlisted drifts invisibly - and ownership is not partitionable, since scripts/cwk_tenant_cli.py is exercised by RT-012, RT-013 and RT-014 alike. Binding the whole non-evidence tree means a newly added script or test is in scope automatically, so forgetting to update this registry makes gates stricter rather than weaker.

candidate_tree_excluded_prefixes.description: The four receipt roots. Excluded because they are EVIDENCE OUTPUT: if a gate's own receipt were inside the digest, writing the evidence would change the subject the evidence describes and no fixed point would exist.

candidate_tree_excluded_patterns.description: The sixteen RT reports directories, as one anchored pattern. Same rationale as the receipt roots.

rt_owner_code_patterns.description: Regex templates completing each RT's TOUCH scope beyond its package directory. Not the owner-tree basis; a supplementary signal only.

rt_owner_code_prefixes.description: Per-RT package TOUCH prefixes: specs, tasks and the intake document, plus the exact remediated runtime owned by RT-012/Stage-09 or RT-013/Stage-10. Deliberately excludes reports/, which is evidence output. Combined with rt_owner_code_patterns for the touch and legacy-no-drift checks; NOT the owner-tree basis.

rt_owner_evidence_prefixes.description: Per-RT owner EVIDENCE-OUTPUT prefixes. A commit touching only these does NOT satisfy 'the subject commit touched the feeder packages'.

excluded_evidence_prefixes.description: The four receipt roots. Never owner code, for the same reason reports/ is not: a receipt must not be able to manufacture its own subject binding.

gate_owner_scope_rt_ids.description: The RTs whose owner code each gate's subject binding covers. G6 is the case that matters: its feeder_rts are only RT-024..RT-026, but its owner scope is the RT-017..RT-026 union, because it directly cites all ten acceptances. Scoping G6 to its three feeders would leave RT-017..RT-023 code drift invisible to the final gate.

g6_fresh_evidence_common_fields.description: Fields EVERY fresh_evidence_refs entry must carry, regardless of role. Frozen so that a new role cannot be introduced with a thinner binding than the existing nine.

g6_fresh_evidence_roles.description: The EXACT nine required completion roles for a G6 receipt. The role multiset of fresh_evidence_refs must EQUAL this set: a missing role and an unknown role are equally invalid, and there is no 'covered by another run' allowance.

required_role_fields.description: Role-specific fields beyond g6_fresh_evidence_common_fields. These carry the semantics that role names alone cannot: findings_count for secret_scan, open_blocker_count/open_major_count for final_findings_reconciliation, and so on.

prerequisite_resolution.description: How a prerequisite_refs[] entry is BOUND to real evidence. A ref_id is a label, not a binding: an earlier revision compared ref_id against a caller-supplied {ref_id: hash} map, so any 64-hex string injected under the right key satisfied the check. Resolution is therefore canonical (the path comes from a declared authority, never from the caller), typed (family and schema must agree) and recomputed (the hash is derived from the bytes the fail-closed reader actually returned).

families.description: One entry per prerequisite id family. Every id in any required_prerequisite_ids must match EXACTLY ONE family's ref_id_pattern, and an id matching zero families is unresolvable and therefore invalid.

schema_id.description: The schema id the referenced JSON body must declare, or null for the two Markdown families. A body carrying a different schema id is a cross-family substitution and is rejected even when path and hash are correct.

path_source.description: The DECLARED AUTHORITY that maps ref_id to its canonical path. Never the caller, and never a path pattern the caller's value merely has to match.

forbidden_paths.description: Paths that are explicitly rejected for this family even though they exist, are readable and hash stably. These enumerate the PLAUSIBLE SUBSTITUTES - chiefly the superseded round-4 review - because those are what a lenient resolver actually accepts.

markdown_acceptance_marker.description: The frozen machine-parseable block for marker_style=cwk_acceptance_v1. Naive substring matching on the word PASS is explicitly forbidden: PASS occurs in ordinary prose, in quoted contract text and in tables of contents, so a substring test accepts reports that say the opposite of what they are read to say.

bootstrap_report_id.description: The report_id the G0 final Wave-0 review report must declare in its marker block.

rt_acceptance_reports.description: The canonical acceptance report for each RT. RT-011 deliberately resolves to 独立验收报告-r2.md because the un-suffixed RT-011 report is retained as historical FAILED evidence. RT-012 and RT-013 deliberately resolve to new Stage-09/Stage-10 reports because their original acceptances predate remediated runtime changes. A resolver that guessed filenames by convention would therefore bind failed or stale evidence under a passing id.

report_path.description: Exact path inside the RT's own package. Acceptance reports never live under a receipt root.

report_sha256.description: Required for marker_style=legacy_frozen_hash: the raw SHA-256 of the exact historical bytes. The document is bound by this hash and is NEVER parsed, so grandfathered reports need no edit and their prose can never be re-interpreted.

accepted_subject_commit.description: Required for marker_style=legacy_frozen_hash: the reviewed, immutable transcription of the commit that acceptance actually certified. Carrying it forward requires legacy_acceptance_drift_rule.

historical_verdict.description: Frozen transcription of the HISTORICAL review outcome for the pinned bytes. Deliberately NOT named `verdict`: forbiddenEntryKeys bans verdict/status/result so that this registry can never record whether a release gate ran or passed, and that guard is not weakened here. This field records an outcome of a FOREIGN, already-closed, hash-pinned artefact - it says nothing about G1..G7 - and it may appear ONLY on a legacy_frozen_hash entry.

superseded_legacy_report.description: Closed provenance object for an original report superseded by a declared compatibility stage. Only RT-012/Stage-09 and RT-013/Stage-10 have such an object. It is not a second acceptance candidate and its report_path is forbidden by the rt_acceptance family.

then.description: Grandfathering is a CLOSED exception. A cwk_acceptance_v1 entry must NOT carry a frozen transcription, otherwise a future report could be pinned to a hash and a verdict without ever being parsed.

allOf.description: RT-012 moved to a new Stage-09 acceptance. The old report remains required closed provenance but can never be the canonical path.
RT-013 moved to a new Stage-10 acceptance. The old report remains required closed provenance but can never be the canonical path.
The grandfathered style set is closed and excludes both remediated RTs.
All future RT acceptances use cwk_acceptance_v1 and may not carry either remediated RT's superseded provenance object.

go_no_go_report_path.description: RT-026's machine-readable go/no-go output. It lives in RT-026's own package, OUTSIDE every receipt root: those roots are governed by exact closure rules, so a report inside one is either an undeclared extra file that fails closure or forces a per-file exception, and a closure rule with an exception is not a closure rule.

gate_kind.description: release_verification for G1..G6; release_authorization for G7 alone.

receipt_path.description: G1..G6 use receipt.json; G7 uses authorization.json so that a directory walk keyed on receipt semantics can never mistake an authorization for a verification pass.

feeder_rts.description: RT packages whose independent PASS this gate certifies. Empty for G7, which certifies nothing.

scope_ceiling.description: Static upper bound on what a PASS of this gate may be read to mean. Never a run outcome.

consumes_verification_gates.description: RELEASE-GATE consumer relation. Inverse must be VG-A -> {G3,G6}, VG-B -> {G6}, VG-C -> {G4,G6}, VG-D -> {G5,G6}, VG-E -> {G6}. This is NOT the direct-RT-consumer relation in gate_registry_v1.json.

direct_rt_consumers.description: RT packages that read THIS release gate receipt as an input. RT-026 consumes G1..G5 only; nothing consumes G6 or G7, which are strictly downstream of every RT.

producer_role.description: wave_release_verifier for G1..G5; fresh_final_independent_verifier for G6; external_authorizing_principal for G7. No project implementation agent appears in this enum at all.

requires_external_authorization.description: True only for G7. This is a static policy declaration, not an execution status.

required_prerequisite_ids.description: EXACT frozen prerequisite set. A receipt's prerequisite_refs[].ref_id set must EQUAL this, not merely be contained in it. The pattern bounds the id space to release gates G0..G6, RT-011..RT-026, VG-A..VG-E, capability activations (CAP:), security gate receipts (SG:) and the RT-026 go/no-go report; G7 is excluded by pattern because nothing may verify against an authorization.

static_note.description: Static rule/scope statement only. Must never describe a run outcome.

semanticRules: The registry is frozen configuration: neither the top level, nor bootstrap_gate, nor any gate entry may carry a mutable execution status (see forbiddenEntryKeys). In particular `authorized` is forbidden, so the registry can declare that G7 REQUIRES authorization without ever recording that it HAS it.

Runtime status is derived only from receipt_path existence plus the status/conclusion inside that receipt. No release gate receipt exists today, so all seven entries are NOT_RUN and none may be reported otherwise.
gate_id values are unique and cover exactly {G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6, G7}. G0 must NOT appear in `gates`; it exists only inside bootstrap_gate with in_registry=false.

gate_kind is release_verification for exactly {G1..G6} and release_authorization for exactly {G7}; receipt_schema_id must agree with gate_kind, and requires_external_authorization must be true exactly when gate_kind is release_authorization.

receipt_path is unique per gate and its G{n} segment matches gate_id; G1..G6 end in /receipt.json and G7 ends in /authorization.json. A receipt.json under G7 or an authorization.json under G1..G6 is invalid.

receipt_root must be disjoint from the verification gate root gate-receipts/. Merging them would break the existing exact VG closure, which requires every receipt.json under gate-receipts/ to sit at a VG registry path, and would force that check to be weakened. Neither root's closure rule may be relaxed to accommodate the other family.

Closure is judged over the WHOLE receipt_root subtree: after recursive enumeration every regular file must land exactly on a declared receipt_path or on a declared archive_dir member named <its own recomputed hash>.json. Symlinks at any component or leaf, dotfiles, non-regular files, nested extra receipts and stray JSON beside a declared receipt are hard failures, not bonuses.

required_prerequisite_ids is EXACT: a receipt's prerequisite_refs[].ref_id set must equal it. A missing id and an extra id are equally invalid, so neither a weakened gate nor a padded one can be presented as compliant.
No entry's required_prerequisite_ids may contain its own gate_id or any later release gate; the frozen order is G1 < G2 < G3 < G4 < G5 < G6 < G7.
No entry's required_prerequisite_ids may contain G7 (enforced by pattern). G7 is an authorization, never evidence of verification, so nothing may verify against it.

G1's required_prerequisite_ids is exactly {G0, RT-011}. G0 resolves only through bootstrap_gate.final_wave0_review_report_path; the historical r4 report is explicitly insufficient because it reviewed a superseded revision of the documents. That path being absent makes G0 unsatisfied and G1 permanently NOT_RUN until an independent reviewer produces it.

The frozen DAG is exactly: G1={G0,RT-011}; G2={G1,RT-012,RT-013}; G3={G2,RT-014,RT-015,RT-016,VG-A}; G4={G3,RT-019,RT-020,RT-021,VG-C}; G5={G4,RT-022,RT-023,VG-D,CAP:gateway-identity-transport}; G6={G1..G5, RT-017..RT-026, VG-A..VG-E, both CAP activations, all ten SG:RT-0xx receipts, RT-026-GO-NO-GO}; G7={G6}.

The closed legacy_frozen_hash set is exactly {RT-011, RT-014, RT-015, RT-016}. RT-012 and RT-013 resolve only to RT/RT-012/reports/独立验收报告-stage09.md and RT/RT-013/reports/独立验收报告-stage10.md with marker_style=cwk_acceptance_v1; each original report is retained only in its own exact closed superseded_legacy_report object and is forbidden as a prerequisite path.

Every RT entry with marker_style=cwk_acceptance_v1 requires both implementer_ids and reviewer_ids. G0 alone uses the six-field cwk marker because it is a document review. RT-012 touch scope alone contains exact path scripts/cwk_instance.py and RT-013 touch scope alone contains exact path scripts/cwk_agent_binding.py; neither selector may appear under another RT.

legacy_acceptance_drift_rule has no re-run bypass: ancestry and byte-identical owner scope are both mandatory for every legacy_frozen_hash prerequisite. If a legacy RT evolves, its canonical entry must move to cwk_acceptance_v1 rather than accepting a caller-supplied fresh flag.
G6 cites G1 THROUGH G5 individually rather than relying on G5 transitively, so that a revoked, expired or hash-drifted mid-chain gate cannot survive undetected inside a downstream conclusion.

G6's producer_role must be fresh_final_independent_verifier and its direct_rt_consumers must be empty. G6 is strictly downstream of RT-026: RT-026 neither reads nor writes it, and any implementation that treats a G6 receipt as an RT-026 input is a self-dependency cycle and a contract violation.

G7 is a NARROW-AUTHORITY exception: its required_prerequisite_ids is exactly {G6} and it does not re-consume RT, VG or G1..G5 evidence. Separating duties this way means the authorizer can only answer whether an already-verified candidate may be deployed, never whether it was verified.

consumes_verification_gates is the RELEASE-GATE consumer relation and its inverse must be exactly VG-A -> {G3,G6}, VG-B -> {G6}, VG-C -> {G4,G6}, VG-D -> {G5,G6}, VG-E -> {G6}. It is a SEPARATE relation from `consumers` in gate_registry_v1.json, which lists DIRECT RT consumers and whose value space is exactly {RT-024, RT-026}. A release gate must never be added to `consumers`, and an RT must never be added to consumes_verification_gates.
Every gate listed in consumes_verification_gates must also appear in that gate's required_prerequisite_ids: consuming a VG without citing its hash would let the VG evidence drift silently.

A release gate that consumes VG-x must never appear in VG-x's allowed_prerequisite_ids in gate_registry_v1.json, because a gate cannot be upstream of its own input. G3/VG-A, G4/VG-C and G5/VG-D are the three affected pairs and both files must agree.

G3's scope ceiling is data/migration level only. Its VG-A input is permanently synthetic with a conclusion ceiling of conservative_unknown, so a G3 PASS is contagiously capped: it may never be read as query-level, runtime-level or production-level verification, and never as a substitute for RT-016.

G5 must cite CAP:gateway-identity-transport. The direction is fixed: that activation receipt is issued by RT-023 AFTER its own independent PASS, so it is a product of RT-023 and a prerequisite of G5, never a prerequisite of RT-023. Reading it the other way creates an RT-023 self-dependency cycle.

RT-026's terminal conclusion token READY_FOR_G7_REVIEW means exactly READY_FOR_G6_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE. The name is a frozen v1 misnomer retained to avoid an unversioned break of synthetic_closure_map_v1.json; it must always be glossed as 'may be submitted to G6 final acceptance' and never rendered as G7_AUTHORIZED, RELEASE_APPROVED or GA_READY. G6's own conclusion ceiling is READY_FOR_G7_AUTHORIZATION, which is likewise not a deployment authorization.

Prerequisites being satisfied is a precondition for RUNNING a gate, never a substitute for its receipt. A gate whose inputs are all green and whose receipt is missing is NOT_RUN, and a downstream gate must fail closed rather than infer it.
